T0544.title: Configuration Drift
T0544.definition: A deviation between the actual runtime configuration and the approved security or operations baseline.
T0544.description: Configuration drift means live settings have diverged from the approved security or operations baseline, such as temporary permission openings, manual gateway changes, disabled logging, or out-of-band releases. Drift makes audit documents differ from real risk. Controls require baseline detection, configuration as code, change approval, and rollback capability.
T0544.usageExample: Assess Configuration Drift related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
